title: MS2 spectra from mzML
doc: Reads the MS2 scans of data-dependent runs and writes them as spectra with precursor m/z and intensity, charge, RT and scan number.

min_intensity.title: Peak threshold
min_intensity.description: Peaks below this intensity are dropped; a scan left with no peak is dropped

max_isolation.title: Largest isolation window
max_isolation.description: Scans whose isolation window is wider are dropped; off when absent, and a scan that does not say its window is kept
